data.title: Liverpool v Brighton: Prediction, team news, lineups and odds
data.content:
Brighton have made a brilliant start to the 2026/27 season, but will face one of their biggest tests when they play Liverpool at Anfield.

The Seagulls won 5-0 against Crystal Palace last weekend and now sit third in the Premier League with 16 points from their opening seven games.

Liverpool came from 1-0 down to win 2-1 away at Brentford in their last league outing and are fifth in the table, four points behind Brighton.

## Liverpool v Brighton kick-off time [...] Liverpool v Brighton kicks off at 2pm GMT on Sunday, October 25 at Anfield.

## Liverpool v Brighton how to watch

The game will be shown live in the UK via Sky Sports Premier League, with coverage starting from 12.30pm.

BBC Radio Sports Extra 2 will provide full match radio commentary.

## Liverpool team news

Jeremie Frimpong and Dominik Szoboszlai both sustained hamstring injuries against Brentford last weekend, while Victor Munoz picked up a minor knee injury. [...] The likes of Ferdi Kadioglu, Luka Vuskovic, Lewis Dunk, Chema Andres, Yasin Ayari and Charalampos Kostoulas are also set to be recalled to the starting line-up.

Pascal Struijk (thigh), Yankuba Minteh (ankle) and Mats Wieffer (knee) are close to a return and could be named in the matchday squad at Anfield.

Kaoru Mitoma is continuing his recovery from a hamstring injury sustained in pre-season, while Stefanos Tzimas and Evan Ferguson are long-term absentees.
